rv.q: It's a lot to attempt in 80 minutes, and the result is a show in which neither humor nor pathos finds focus.
But This Is My Favorite Song remains too vague and inconsistent to merit a spot on a Spotify playlist.
Indeed, This is My Favorite Song is a kind of tightrope act: D'Uva finds laughter in loss without minimizing the pain that comes with it.
Often somber, but ultimately uplifting, Francesca holds our hands through what was a brutal time for her and a touching learning experience for us.
The show just needs a bit more corralling to get this scrappy material into a seamless show.
